title: Sydney Opera House
summary: The Sydney Opera House in New South Wales, Australia, began construction on 2 March 1959 and was opened by Queen Elizabeth II on 20 October 1973. Permasteelisa lists it as 67 m high, 183 m long and 120 m wide at its widest point, with architects Hall, Todd and Littlemore and Jorn Utzon. UNESCO World Heritage status followed in 2007.

uncertainty.note: Start is 2 March 1959 (Sydney Opera House). Opened 20 October 1973 (Sydney Opera House, Archiweb). End is the present: the building stands.
